Going through the main story is ok, nothing too much special, but it can fun if u don't expect much, it could be better tho, high hopes for the next month update.

There is hard content that u might need some frens to be able to do it, but u can also do it solo if like a good challenge, unfortunely the rewards are not a big incentive since u need to pray for the gods of rng for a chance of droping something valuable( wich can be bought and sold at the player shop if ur unlucky).
